rendering.centering: each thresholded glyph ink bbox centered independently with floor((64-extent)/2)
rendering.downsample: nonoverlapping 2x2 area mean, threshold >=0.5 to binary 32x32
rendering.similarity: float32 L2-normalized 32x32 binary-vector cosine nearest neighbor

protocol.validation_use: Neither the specified 227 calibration exclusions nor any of the 275 Task 1 validation pictures is rendered, matched, or used to select rendering parameters in Stage A.

preregistered_selection_rules.best_configuration: highest median_best_cosine; ties by highest mean_best_cosine, lower top1_duplicate_occupancy_rate, earlier font order, then smaller font size
preregistered_selection_rules.top1_duplicate_occupancy_rate: (N - number of unique top1 candidate indices) / N
preregistered_selection_rules.stage_b_candidates: the first at most 3 configurations in the same calibration ranking
preregistered_selection_rules.stage_b_selection: maximum official OCF on test11 tune=shuffled[:16] only; ties retain calibration rank
preregistered_selection_rules.held_out_rule: evaluate only the tune-selected font configuration on shuffled[64:], plus the fixed independent training-bank baseline

preregistered_stage_a_gate.combination: all four criteria are required; otherwise save calibration.json and stop without Task 1 font retrieval

conclusion: Stage A passed; only the three preselected calibration configurations may enter Stage B.
